title: TAKETHIS accepted in IHAVE mode: RFC 4644 violation
description: 5w3.28: peering session.rs check_mode_guard allows TAKETHIS in IHAVE mode. RFC 4644 §2.5 MUST NOT accept TAKETHIS unless MODE STREAM was negotiated. Fix: check_mode_guard for TAKETHIS must reject in IHAVE mode with '500 not in streaming mode'.
